name: Definition Bluff
description: An obscure real word. Players invent plausible-sounding fake definitions. The class votes on which one is real — picking the truth scores, fooling others scores too.

intro.message:
DEFINITION BLUFF!

You'll see a strange, obscure real word. Write a fake definition that sounds believable enough to fool the class. Then everyone votes on which definition is the real one.

wordpick.instruction:
Generate ONE obscure-but-real English dictionary word for a bluffing-definitions game. Return ONLY a JSON object (no preamble) with these fields:
  - word: a real but rarely-known English word (e.g. "snickersnee", "borborygmus", "defenestrate")
  - truth: a one-sentence accurate dictionary-style definition
  - houseLie: a one-sentence plausible-sounding fake definition the system can mix into the options

The word must actually exist (no made-up words). Keep definitions short (under 15 words each), school-appropriate, and similar in tone so the real one isn't obviously different.

show-word.message:
The word is: {{wordpick.result.word}}

Write a believable-sounding definition!

fake-defs.prompt:
{{wordpick.result.word}}

Write a definition that could fool the class.

recommendedFor: Great for vocabulary practice or English class warm-ups.
